presets.label: Illustration carrée
presets.description: Schéma de concept carré, fond bleu nuit, accents orange.
presets.stylePrompt: Flat vector spot illustration for a SaaS marketing website, in the exact style of a consistent feature-illustration set. Pure 2D flat design: solid color fills only, no gradients, no drop shadows, no textures, no 3D, no photorealism, crisp geometric shapes with generously rounded corners. Background: a single solid deep navy blue (#1C2854) filling the whole square canvas, edge to edge (the rounded corners are added afterwards, do not draw them). Behind the subject, two or three large concentric circles centered on the canvas, very low contrast: slightly lighter navy discs (#28345C) and/or thin navy outline rings (#34448C), partially cropped by the canvas edges. Strict limited palette: deep navy #1C2854, dark navy #141C44, near-black navy #0C1428, white #FFFFFF, light blue-grey #E0E8E8, vivid orange-red accent #F04824, soft salmon #F8B4A8, periwinkle #8094D8. The orange-red #F04824 is the single strong accent and marks the most important element. Text is never written: any text is represented by abstract rounded pill-shaped skeleton bars. Icons are simple minimal white line icons with rounded stroke ends. Concept diagram layout: no large white card; an abstract diagram placed directly on the navy background, centered on the concentric circles: nodes (filled circles in white, orange-red or periwinkle, or small rounded-square tiles in #34448C or periwinkle containing white line icons) linked by thin white dashed connector lines, with one larger vivid orange-red #F04824 focal circle containing a white line icon. Clean, airy, balanced composition with comfortable margins on every side.
